name: Air-Fryer Hara Bhara Kebabs
category: Healthy Indian Snacks and Street Food
ingredients: 150 g spinach, blanched and squeezed dry
½ cup green peas, boiled and mashed
1 green chilli and 1 tsp ginger, minced
½ tsp each garam masala and chaat masala
steps: Mix the spinach, peas, potato, chickpeas, besan, chilli, ginger, spices and salt.
Shape into 8 flat patties and chill for 10 minutes.
Preheat the air fryer to 180°C. Brush the patties lightly with oil.
Air-fry in a single layer for 12 minutes, turning halfway, until firm and lightly crisp.
note: The chickpeas and besan raise the protein above that of a standard potato-based kebab.
